'''Jhorag Corconnan''' was an [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] operative sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tasariq]] to organize [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] resistance cells. As a cover story, he presented himself as a purchasing agent of a gemstone dealer from [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], with a reputation for being friendly and fair, though also dull and forgettable. He was always accompanied by an [[A2 Accounting/Business Unit]], [[A2-ZP]], who was modified to serve as his [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. Corconnan possessed a [[Peridot crystal|peridot]] [[Tasar crystal]] which granted him some ability to [[Control Pain|control pain]]; like many in possession of Tasar crystals, Corconnan became [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].
